name: freshservice
description: Freshservice IT service management integration — list, inspect, create, and update tickets, add notes, list changes, and search assets via the Freshservice REST API v2. Authenticates with an agent API key over HTTP Basic (apiKey as username, 'X' as password) against your {subdomain}.freshservice.com instance.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Freshservice IT service desk — tickets, changes, and assets

fields.label: Freshservice URL
fields.helpText: Your Freshservice instance URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.freshservice.com

fields.label: API Key
fields.helpText: Your agent API key from Profile Settings. An admin must have API access enabled for your agent account.

tools.name: freshservice.list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets in the service desk, optionally restricted to a predefined filter or to tickets updated since a timestamp. Returns a trimmed summary with human-readable status and priority.

updated_since.description: Only return tickets updated at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z)

tools.name: freshservice.get_ticket
tools.description: Get a ticket's details (subject, description, status, priority, requester) together with its conversation thread (replies and notes, trimmed).

tools.name: freshservice.list_changes
tools.description: List change requests with subject, human-readable status (Open, Planning, Approval, Pending Release, Pending Review, Closed), risk, and planned start/end dates.

tools.name: freshservice.search_assets
tools.description: Search CMDB assets by name, asset tag, or serial number (exact match per the Freshservice search syntax). Fails with a clear message if the plan lacks the asset module.

query.description: The value to search for (exact match)

tools.name: freshservice.create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new incident ticket on behalf of a requester email (source is set to Portal).

email.description: Requester email address the ticket is created for

tools.name: freshservice.update_ticket
tools.description: Update a ticket's status, priority, and/or assigned group.

groupId.description: Agent group id to assign the ticket to

tools.name: freshservice.add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a ticket's conversation (private by default; set private to false for a public note visible to the requester).

ticketId.description: The ticket id to add the note to

private.description: Whether the note is private/internal (default true)
